title: waivers
description: <repo>/.ai-flow/waivers.json — a repository's own check waivers. Written only by `standards waive`, and only after the developer confirmed (exit 4 waiver_confirmation, then --confirmed). Not a ticket handoff artifact: it lives in the repository, is committed with it, and is read by every ticket that touches that repository. `expires` is required and an expired waiver re-fires; `secrets` checks cannot be waived; sections cannot be waived at all, only overridden.

waivers.description: Sorted by check_id — at most one waiver per check.

created.description: RFC 3339 instant the waiver was written — one of the few real clock values in the system, and exempt from byte-stability for the same reason a status.json approval's `at` is.

expires.description: RFC 3339 instant, or a bare YYYY-MM-DD date meaning midnight UTC that day. Required: a waiver without an expiry is a silent permanent suppression.
